description: This file defines classes and templates for Ethernet and IP frame processing, including Ethernet frames, IPv4, TCP, and UDP frames, with methods for loading, validating, and manipulating network packet headers.

classes.name: EthernetFrameType
classes.description: Template class representing an Ethernet frame with methods to load and access MAC addresses and frame data.

classes.name: IPv4FrameType
classes.description: Template class representing an IPv4 network packet, with methods to access and modify IP header fields, load data, and validate checksum.

classes.name: TCPv4FrameType
classes.description: Template class representing a TCP over IPv4 packet, with methods to access source/destination ports and load data.

classes.name: UDPv4FrameType
classes.description: Template class representing a UDP over IPv4 packet, with methods to access source/destination ports, load data, and validate checksum.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads data into the frame buffer from a given byte array.

methods.name: SourceMAC
methods.description: Gets or sets the source MAC address in the Ethernet frame.

methods.name: DestinationMAC
methods.description: Gets or sets the destination MAC address in the Ethernet frame.

methods.name: Source
methods.description: Gets or sets the source NodeId in IPv4, TCP, and UDP frames.

methods.name: Destination
methods.description: Gets or sets the destination NodeId in IPv4, TCP, and UDP frames.

methods.name: Protocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol field from the IPv4 header.

methods.name: TTL
methods.description: Gets or sets the Time To Live (TTL) field in IPv4 header.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Gets or sets the total length of the IPv4 packet or payload length in UDP.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the total size of the IPv4 packet.

methods.name: Checksum
methods.description: Calculates or retrieves the checksum for IPv4 or UDP headers.

methods.name: Frame
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the frame data excluding headers.
